description: Orchestrator polls Redis queue at configured interval and receives new issue payloads
steps: Set POLL_INTERVAL_SEC environment variable
Start the Agent Pod
Observe that the orchestrator calls RPOP on agent-queue every POLL_INTERVAL_SEC seconds
Verify a log entry is emitted each polling cycle even when the queue is empty

description: GitHub Actions workflow enqueues a new issue payload to Redis via LPUSH
steps: Open a new GitHub Issue in the target repository
Verify the trigger-agent.yml workflow starts
Confirm an LPUSH is executed against agent-queue with type=issue
Confirm the payload contains issueNumber, repoOwner, repoName, and body

description: Orchestrator dequeues an issue task from Redis using RPOP
steps: Manually LPUSH a JSON task payload to agent-queue
Wait one polling cycle
Verify the orchestrator logs show the task was dequeued
Verify the queue is empty after dequeue

description: Orchestrator enqueues a CodeRabbit review feedback payload to Redis
steps: Trigger a pull_request_review_comment event from coderabbitai[bot]
Verify the trigger-agent.yml workflow starts with type=review
Confirm the payload is pushed to agent-queue with issueNumber and body fields
Verify the orchestrator dequeues and identifies it as a review task

description: AgentSession is created in Redis with status=developing when a new issue task is dequeued
steps: Dequeue an issue task
Query Redis for key session:{issueNumber}
Verify the session JSON contains status=developing, iteration=0, and branchName=agent/issue-{N}

description: AgentSession can be read from Redis by issue number
steps: Create a session in Redis manually via SET
Call the session read function with the corresponding issue number
Verify the returned struct matches the stored JSON

description: AgentSession is updated in Redis when status transitions occur
steps: Create a session with status=developing
Call the session update function with status=review_pending and a prNumber
Query Redis and confirm the new values are persisted
Verify the TTL is still set to 24 hours

description: AgentSession transitions from developing to review_pending after PR is created
steps: Process an issue task end-to-end through implementation and PR creation
Verify the session status transitions to review_pending
Confirm prNumber is set in the session

description: AgentSession transitions from review_pending to fixing when a review task is dequeued
steps: Create a session with status=review_pending
Dequeue a review task for the same issue number
Verify the session transitions to fixing and iteration increments by 1

description: AgentSession transitions to done after a successful fix cycle
steps: Create a session with status=fixing and iteration=1
Complete the fix cycle without error
Verify the session status is set to done

description: AgentSession transitions to aborted when MAX_ITERATION is reached
steps: Set MAX_ITERATION=2
Create a session with status=fixing and iteration=2
Trigger another review task for the same issue
Verify the session status is set to aborted and the iteration is not incremented further

description: LLM generates an implementation plan from an issue body via Anthropic API
steps: Call the LLM function with a sample issue body
Verify the Anthropic API is called with the issue text in the prompt
Confirm the returned implementation plan is a non-empty string

description: LLM generates a fix plan from CodeRabbit review feedback and existing code
steps: Call the LLM fix function with a sample review comment and code snippet
Verify the Anthropic API is called with both the feedback and the existing code
Confirm the returned fix plan is a non-empty string

description: Sandbox is started and returns a usable session handle
steps: Call the sandbox creation function
Verify no error is returned
Confirm a sandbox ID is assigned and logged

description: Sandbox clones the target repository into /workspace
steps: Start a sandbox session
Execute sb.Run with the git clone command
Verify the exit code is 0
Call sb.Run with ls /workspace to confirm the repository contents are present

description: Sandbox writes a generated code file using sb.Write with filename only (no path)
steps: Start a sandbox session
Call sb.Write with a filename containing no path separator and valid Go source content
Verify no error is returned
Confirm the file is present in the sandbox via sb.Run ls

description: Sandbox moves a written file into a subdirectory using mkdir and mv commands
steps: Start a sandbox session
Call sb.Run with mkdir -p pkg/
Call sb.Write with a filename only
Call sb.Run with mv {filename} pkg/
Verify the file exists at pkg/{filename} via sb.Run ls pkg/

description: Sandbox builds the project with go build ./...
steps: Clone the target repository into the sandbox
Write necessary implementation files
Call sb.Run with go build ./...
Verify exit code is 0 and no build errors are logged

description: Sandbox runs the test suite with go test ./...
steps: Clone the target repository into the sandbox
Write implementation files
Call sb.Run with go test ./...
Verify exit code is 0 and test output is captured in logs

description: Sandbox commits and pushes to a feature branch
steps: Clone the target repository
Write code and run build/test
Call sb.Run with git checkout -b agent/issue-{N}
Call sb.Run with git add . and git commit
Call sb.Run with git push origin agent/issue-{N}
Verify the branch appears in the remote repository

description: Sandbox session is closed with sb.Close() after processing completes
steps: Complete a sandbox code execution workflow
Call sb.Close()
Verify no error is returned
Confirm the sandbox Pod is terminated in Kubernetes

description: GitHub PR is created for the feature branch via GitHub API
steps: Push a feature branch to the target repository
Call the GitHub PR creation function with title, body, branch name, and base branch
Verify a PR is created in the repository
Confirm the returned PR number is stored in the session

description: GitHub PR body includes the issue number for automatic linking
steps: Create a PR via the GitHub API function
Inspect the PR body
Verify it contains Closes #{issueNumber} or Fixes #{issueNumber}

description: CodeRabbit review comment is parsed and the feedback body is extracted
steps: Feed a raw review task payload from Redis into the review parsing function
Verify the function returns the comment body without error
Confirm the issueNumber and prNumber are also extracted correctly

description: Iterative fix loop passes review feedback and current code to the LLM and writes the fix to sandbox
steps: Create a session in fixing state with iteration=1
Read existing code from sandbox via sb.Read
Call the LLM fix function with review feedback and existing code
Write the generated fix back to sandbox via sb.Write
Verify build and tests pass after the fix

description: Iterative fix loop pushes updated code to the existing feature branch, updating the open PR
steps: Complete a fix cycle in sandbox
Call sb.Run with git add . and git commit
Call sb.Run with git push origin agent/issue-{N}
Verify the existing open PR shows the new commit in GitHub

description: MAX_ITERATION environment variable controls the maximum number of fix iterations
steps: Set MAX_ITERATION=3
Start the orchestrator
Verify that on the 4th review task for the same session the orchestrator aborts instead of fixing

description: Orchestrator posts a comment on the GitHub Issue when MAX_ITERATION is exceeded
steps: Set MAX_ITERATION=2
Trigger review tasks until iteration exceeds the limit
Verify a comment is posted to the GitHub Issue indicating the agent has aborted
Confirm the session status is set to aborted

description: POLL_INTERVAL_SEC environment variable controls the Redis polling interval
steps: Set POLL_INTERVAL_SEC=5
Start the orchestrator
Observe that polling occurs approximately every 5 seconds in logs
Verify default of 30 seconds is used when the variable is not set

description: All required environment variables are validated at startup and the process exits with a clear error if any are missing
steps: Start the orchestrator without setting ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Verify the process exits immediately with a non-zero exit code
Confirm the error message identifies which variable is missing
